description: Exact zero-energy matrix-product eigenstate at every finite length L of a nearest-neighbour, periodic, Hermitian spin-1/2 chain. All data are exact integers.

conventions.amplitude_convention: psi(s_1..s_L) = Tr(A^{s_1} A^{s_2} ... A^{s_L}), s_1 most significant
conventions.boundary_conditions: periodic; site L+1 identified with site 1

bond_operator_h.definition: h = -(I + X) tensor (X + Z), acting on sites (i, i+1)

certificate.identity: sum_{s,t} <uv|h|st> A^s A^t = C^u A^v - A^u C^v   for all u,v in {0,1}   (16 scalar equations, all satisfied)
certificate.mechanism: Derrida-Evans-Hakim-Pasquier / matrix-product-ansatz telescoping; existence for any injective MPS eigenstate is guaranteed by Garre Rubio, Molnar, Schuch, Verstraete (arXiv:2603.28349); explicit eigenstate form h A A = E A - A E in Gehrmann & Essler (arXiv:2605.03020, Eq. 10)
certificate.consequence: The right-hand side telescopes around the periodic trace, so H|psi_L> = 0 for every L (eigenvalue E = 0).

verified_properties.H_psi_zero_exact: L = 3..10 (dense integer substitution; reverify.py P2), and L = 3..9 (independent numpy build; xcheck.py)
verified_properties.genuine_bond_dimension_2: {I, A0, A1, A0 A1} spans M_2(C); coefficient determinant = -4 (reverify.py P5)
verified_properties.not_frustration_free: a single bond term h_{1,2}|psi_4> is nonzero (reverify.py P6)
verified_properties.rotated_east_type_form: U with U X U^{-1}=Z, U Z U^{-1}=-X maps H to -2 sum_i P0_i (Z - X)_{i+1}, P0 = |0><0| = (I+Z)/2 (reverify.py P7)

claim: The translation-invariant, periodic, bond-dimension-2 MPS with the integer matrices A0, A1 above is an exact E = 0 eigenstate at every finite length L of H = - sum_i (I + X_i)(X_{i+1} + Z_{i+1}) (periodic). It is genuinely bond-dimension 2 and its odd/even sublattice Schmidt rank is 2, 4, 8 at L = 4, 6, 8.
scope: Object-level statement only. The telescoping matrix-product-ansatz certificate is a published, standard technique (DEHP 1993), credited at point of use. Non-thermality of the host spectrum is NOT asserted.
